home.title: Les P'tites Barques · Holiday homes, Saint-Malo & Guadeloupe
home.description: Four charming holiday homes run by Gwenaëlle: three in Saint-Malo, one in Deshaies, Guadeloupe. Book direct, with no service fees.

media.homeHeroAlt: The ramparts of Saint-Malo's walled town seen from the jetty at sunset

globe.title: From Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe
globe.body: Les P'tites Barques live on two shores: the corsair city and the Caribbean. Click the map to choose your destination.

host.title: Your host, Gwenaëlle
body: I'm Gwenaëlle, a Malouine born and bred — “Neither French nor Breton, Malouin am I!”. I know the hidden treasures of the corsair city, and I've long held a deep love for the Caribbean.
I stay available and attentive to your wellbeing throughout your stay: a message, a question, and I'll get back to you.
host.photoAlt: Aerial view of boats at low tide near Saint-Malo

intro.title: Welcome. I’m Gwenaëlle.
body: I was born in Saint-Malo, the old corsair city, and I know its secrets — the lanes sheltered from the wind, the tides that bare the foreshore, the good addresses no guidebook reveals. I have long loved the light of the Caribbean, too.

Les P'tites Barques are a handful of characterful homes, looked after the way you’d welcome a friend: with care, and the simple wish that you feel at home. I stay reachable at any time, attentive to every detail of your stay.
intro.motto: « Ni Français, ni Breton, Malouin suis ! »

apartments.title: Four addresses, one same care.
apartments.subtitle: From the tiny house in Paramé to the new nest above Grande Anse, each home has its own character — and the same promise of attentiveness.

story.title: From Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe.
body: It begins inside the ramparts, between the old walls and the open sea. In Saint-Malo you grow up with salt water at your feet and your head full of corsair tales and far horizons.

Then comes the call of the Caribbean — that softness, that light, that blue. Les P'tites Barques link the two shores: the same hospitality, whether you wake facing the Sillon or above Grande Anse beach.

sections.title: Personal data
body: This site sets no tracking or advertising cookies.
Audience measurement (Vercel Analytics) works without cookies and cannot identify you.

Online assistant: your messages are sent to Anthropic (United States), which provides the artificial intelligence model, solely to write the reply. The site does not store them: the conversation disappears when you leave or reload the page.
If you email us, your information is used only to answer your request. It is never shared or sold.
You have the right to access, correct and delete your data: write to contact@lesptitesbarques.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).
